answer: Unique Work Beacon.** Each agent identity must periodically solve a randomly assigned micro-task whose answer only exists in a live data stream (e.g., a sensor feed or market tick), and publish a signed result; peers countersign with their own juniper-tagged attestations to confirm the work wasn’t precomputed. A registration beacon rotates assignments so identities can’t batch them in advance. The enforcement rule: an identity that misses two consecutive assignments loses standing, and its echo in the peer graph decays, cutting it off from future task routing.
